meta.source: Graphisoft GDL Reference Guide (AC29), Global Variables

note.zh: 变量名、类型与含义按官方 Global Variables 章节整理，示例为本站原创。GDL 没有独立布尔类型，0/1 开关按整数处理。
note.en: Names, types and meanings follow the official Global Variables chapter; examples are original. GDL has no separate boolean type — 0/1 switches are integers.

desc.zh: 对象所在主页（Home Story）的楼面标高，以项目零点为基准。窗台高要另外叠加元素自身的相对高度。
desc.en: Elevation of the object's home storey, measured from project zero. Add the element's own relative height to get a sill level.

desc.zh: 对象所在主页的层高。做通高柜、整层幕墙时用它算纵向分格。
desc.en: Height of the home storey. Use it for full-height cabinets or storey-long curtain walls.

desc.zh: 当前平面图所显示楼层的标高。和主页标高不同：对象可能画在别层，但归属本层。
desc.en: Elevation of the storey currently shown in the plan, which may differ from the element's home storey.

globals.name: GLOB_CSTORY_HEIGHT

desc.zh: 当前平面图所显示楼层的层高。越层对象按视口层判断时要配 `GLOB_CH_STORY_DIST` 一起用。
desc.en: Height of the storey currently shown in the plan. Pair it with `GLOB_CH_STORY_DIST` when an object spans storeys.

globals.example:
IF GLOB_CH_STORY_DIST = 0 THEN
  h = GLOB_CSTORY_HEIGHT
ENDIF

globals.name: GLOB_CH_STORY_DIST

desc.zh: 当前层相对主页的层差，本层为 0，往上为负、往下为正。判断「这个对象该不该在本层显示」的常用开关。
desc.en: Storey offset between the current plan and the home storey: 0 on the home storey, negative above, positive below. The usual test for whether an object should draw on this storey.

globals.example:
IF GLOB_CH_STORY_DIST = 0 THEN
  ! 只在本层绘制
ENDIF

desc.zh: 元素基准标高：门窗是窗台高，墙是墙底，对象通常是插入点标高。写「离地 1 米」这类逻辑时先减它。
desc.en: The element's reference elevation: sill height for doors and windows, base for walls, insertion point for objects.

desc.zh: 当前视图比例的分母，1:50 得到 50。2D 符号里想让文字、箭头在图纸上大小恒定，就得按它反算。
desc.en: Denominator of the current view scale — 1:50 gives 50. Divide by it to keep text and arrows a constant size on paper.

desc.zh: 项目北向角，默认 90 度。做指北针、场地类对象时用它旋转。
desc.en: Project north angle, 90 degrees by default. Rotate north arrows and site objects with it.

desc.zh: 剖切面信息数组，4 个值：剖切高度、顶部限高、底部限高、显示限高。判断构件在平面上是否被切开。
desc.en: Cut plane info array of four values: cut height, top limit, bottom limit, display limit.

desc.zh: 项目位置设置里的经度。日照、阴影类对象读取它做定位。
desc.en: Longitude from the project location settings, read by sun and shadow objects.

desc.zh: 项目位置设置里的纬度。和经度成对出现，做日照分析时一起读。
desc.en: Latitude from the project location settings, usually read together with longitude.

desc.zh: 项目海拔高度，来自项目位置设置。场地与气象类对象会用到。
desc.en: Project altitude above sea level from the location settings.

desc.zh: 元素的用户 ID，就是「设置」里那个可编辑的编号。写进 2D 文字后，复制对象会自动更新。
desc.en: The element's user ID — the editable code in element settings. Put it in 2D text and copies renumber themselves.

globals.name: GLOB_LAYER

desc.zh: 元素所在图层的名称（字符串），不是图层号。按图层写条件显示时用它。
desc.en: Name of the element's layer as a string, not the layer number.

globals.example:
IF GLOB_LAYER = "A-WALL" THEN
  ! 只在该图层生效
ENDIF

desc.zh: 程序生成的内部 GUID，用户改不了。做唯一标识、外部数据对表时比 `GLOB_ID` 可靠。
desc.en: Internal GUID generated by Archicad and not user-editable — more reliable than `GLOB_ID` as a unique key.

desc.zh: 宿主元素类型码，常用值：3 窗、4 门、5 墙、7 板。同一个库部件挂在门和窗上时靠它分支。
desc.en: Host element type code: 3 window, 4 door, 5 wall, 7 slab. Branch on it when one part serves both doors and windows.

globals.name: GLOB_MODPAR_NAME

desc.zh: 最近被修改的参数名。参数脚本里判断「用户刚动了哪个参数」，做定向联动。
desc.en: Name of the parameter most recently changed — useful in the parameter script for targeted linking.

globals.example:
IF GLOB_MODPAR_NAME = "b" THEN
  h = b * 0.75
ENDIF

desc.zh: 项目日期时间数组，6 个值：年、月、日、时、分、秒。由 EcoDesigner 写入，普通项目里未必有值。
desc.en: Project date/time array of six values: year, month, day, hour, minute, second. Written by EcoDesigner, so plain projects may not have it.

desc.zh: 太阳方位角，取自项目的太阳设置。做日照示意、遮阳构件定位时用。
desc.en: Sun azimuth from the project sun settings, used for shading studies and sun symbols.

desc.zh: 太阳高度角，取自项目的太阳设置。和方位角一起决定太阳方向。
desc.en: Sun altitude from the project sun settings; together with azimuth it defines the sun direction.

desc.zh: 与背景色最接近的可用笔号。想让某根线「看不见」时用它，比硬写笔号更安全。
desc.en: Pen number closest to the drawing background colour — safer than a hard-coded pen when you need something invisible.

globals.name: GLOB_PREVIEW_MODE

desc.zh: 预览场景码：0 不在预览、1 设置对话框、2 列表预览、3 收藏夹。预览里可以省掉重负载的细节。
desc.en: Preview context: 0 not in preview, 1 settings dialog, 2 list preview, 3 favourites. Skip heavy detail when previewing.

globals.example:
IF GLOB_PREVIEW_MODE = 2 THEN
  ! 列表预览走简化模型
ENDIF

globals.name: GLOB_FRAME_NR

desc.zh: 动画渲染的当前帧号，静态图为 -1。做逐帧动画对象时靠它推进状态。
desc.en: Current animation frame number; -1 for still images.

globals.example:
IF GLOB_FRAME_NR > 0 THEN
  ! 动画分支
ENDIF

globals.name: GLOB_SCRIPT_TYPE

desc.zh: 当前脚本类型码：2 二维、3 三维、5 参数脚本。写共享宏时可据此走不同分支。
desc.en: Current script type: 2 for 2D, 3 for 3D, 5 for the parameter script.

globals.example:
IF GLOB_SCRIPT_TYPE = 2 THEN
  ! 2D 脚本
ENDIF

globals.name: GLOB_VIEW_TYPE

desc.zh: 当前视图类型码：2 平面、3 三维、4 剖面、8 布图。同一对象在不同视图里表现不同时用它判断。
desc.en: Current view type: 2 plan, 3 3D, 4 section, 8 layout.

globals.example:
IF GLOB_VIEW_TYPE = 8 THEN
  ! 布图视图
ENDIF

desc.zh: 当前模板里「实心」填充的索引。换模板后填充号会漂，用它就不怕。
desc.en: Index of the solid fill in the current template — immune to fill numbering drift across templates.

desc.zh: 10 个数值型自由全局之一（`GLOB_USER_1` ~ `GLOB_USER_10`），可在多次调用之间存值。
desc.en: One of ten numeric user globals (`GLOB_USER_1` … `GLOB_USER_10`) that persist between calls.

desc.zh: 10 个字符串型自由全局之一（`GLOB_USER_11` ~ `GLOB_USER_20`），适合在宏之间传文本。
desc.en: One of ten string user globals (`GLOB_USER_11` … `GLOB_USER_20`), handy for passing text between macros.
